capabilities: Add a "Copy to folder…" entry to the file context menu
Copy a file or folder to a chosen folder without renaming it
extras: Works only on desktop. The README is very short and the author describes it as the simplest plugin possible, released without license restrictions ("Do whatever you want with it").
intentEvidence: I would love to see it natively implemented into Obsidian.
motivation: The author would love to see this natively implemented into Obsidian.
problem: Obsidian's file context menu has no built-in way to copy a file or folder to a chosen folder in one step.
summary: Context-menu plugin that adds a "Copy to folder…" option to copy a file or folder to a chosen folder without renaming it.
